---
name: compare-page-structure
description: Review section order, dashboard structure, layout repetition and feature grids.
---

Use DIFF-001, 004, 005 and 009. Confirm the section mapping before comparing. Exclude navigation, footer and repeated catalog entries from a marketing-section inventory. Compare dashboards with dashboards serving the same workflow. Cite the specific sections and the named reference. Repetition can support scanning. Offer a change only if it helps an identified task. Merge observations that lead to the same repair.
